name: Ruddy turnstone
note: The turnstones (B3 wave 2; doc 12 winter, doc 13 'Shaped, not found'): a small winter flock that runs the strandline turning wrack and pebbles. A seasonal life: it counts toward no tier milestone and gives no gift (Matt, October 30, 2026; their moment is the reward). BODY: the bird is recipes/birds/<body.birds>.json (shape, plumage, motion, bake: the small-bird rig, src/world/creatures/bird-rig.js), drawn at its displayScale (the findable scale), the flock bake (bake.flockTris), in both plumages. plumageTurn (Matt, November 1, 2026: show the change even if it runs ahead of the real birds): season positions (0 spring .. 4 the next spring); each bird turns at its own moment within the window, from the chestnut-and-black breeding plumage to winter brown through toWinter as they come back in early autumn, and back to breeding through toBreeding in late winter and spring before they leave. The fields here are what the creatures pass reads (scaleReal, contactShadow, wetSpecular). ECOLOGY (kind flock, src/world/creatures/flock.js): the same arc in the hourly tick as the minnows' (swarms.js: a sign, settling, growing, uneasy, leaving), with the strandline's wrack as their one 'pool': home is what the live watch last measured (src/app/turnstones.js records it in state.creatures.turnstones.home: met, metres of wrack lying, where), so room is one bird per arrival.m2PerOne metres of wrack, up to company.n[2]. Gathered wrack fails the home: they grow uneasy (why 'wrack') and leave after leaveGraceDays. dormancy turnstones (recipes/world/seasons.json): away north from mid-spring to the start of autumn. visit: the S0 visit (src/world/ecology/visits.js) until the home is made. LIFE (src/world/turnstones/live.js): the flock moves along the strand (life.drift), each bird running to a spot near the others and turning wrack (flip) where it lies, pecking, preening, looking about. At night, or with the tide past roostTideM, they roost tight on the highest strand spot above the water (a spiral by rank, then the check below), preening now and then. bodyHalfM: the interference check (live.js separate), each frame: a bird's half width and half length (drawn metres; it is about 0.67 m bill to tail and 0.26 m across the folded wings), so no two bodies overlap however they face (side by side close, nose to tail a body length). spacingM: how far apart they like to feed. PRESENCE: the walker only (the camera above is never felt). Inside the wary ring (ringM, shrunk by trust, scaled by posture and gaze) at Wary the flock flushes: each bird takes off a moment after the last, flies low out over the water and lands flushM along the strand away from you. Past Wary, a bird inside the ring runs aside instead (runAsideM), and only flies inside panicShare of it. Trust: watching only (feedTrust 0, no treats, no name). knownTrust: their group moment (the minnows' rising): from then on, with you still within joinM of them, they forage around your boots (around.nearM..farM).

presence._trust: Their trust (F13 section 8): one for the flock, 0..1, saved (state.creatures.turnstones.trust), only ever grows, earned by quiet watching only. bands: where Tolerant, Curious and Familiar begin; ceiling Curious. knownTrust: the group moment (creature:known), as the minnows' at 0.5.

feed.none: The turnstones would rather find their own food under the wrack.
